regeneration.scope: All 480 M1 transitions (160 per source). Saved fresh checked answers to the identical later-time query are an offline regeneration proxy. No new model calls, candidate selection or online event-triggered policy test. Original generation times were measured on RTX 5090.
regeneration.uncertainty: Episode-first subject-cluster bootstrap, 2000 resamples, seed 20260929; paired differences computed within episode before subject averaging.

archived_corrected_summary.scope: Separate corrected replication; original core is unchanged.

structural.timing_scope: In-memory compiled Boolean witness kernels; includes copying initial cached states, writing precomputed input truths, scheduling, AND/OR claim evaluation and cache writes. Excludes compilation, numerical feature lookup/evaluation, database I/O and generation. Five warmups and 31 randomized-order measurements per cell. Medians of per-cell medians; no database benchmark.
